description:
When a redirect URL cannot be parsed, apply_action previously continued the loop, spinning until timeout. Add a fail-fast branch in the .redirect? case of apply_action that returns Vug.failure with :invalid_redirect error_type when state.current_uri.nil? && decision.next_url.

File: src/vug/fetcher.cr
Related: closes the gap left by vugcr-3co (closed). Already implemented in the working tree (uncommitted).
title: fetcher: add redirect URL parse-fail fail-fast to apply_action
